implications: To stay under the cap the Design Concept After Trades gave up an antitank missile launcher, gave up armor kits for two-thirds of the planned vehicles, and kept a 25 mm cannon. That is why the notional GCV scores -7 on lethality — less lethal than the vehicle it replaces.
statement: The GCV's average procurement unit cost may not exceed $13.5 million in 2013 dollars ($13.0 million in 2011 dollars), set by the Undersecretary of Defense for Acquisition, Technology, and Logistics in August 2011.
